query:
SELECT au.id, au.name, au.email, au.tokenBalance, tt.amount, tt.reason, tt.description, tt.balanceAfter, tt.createdAt
FROM app_users au
LEFT JOIN token_transactions tt ON tt.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.name LIKE '%Linas%'
ORDER BY tt.createdAt DESC;
